title: Fix a failing test
blurb: Two artifacts. The most visible tool differences across harnesses.
prompt: The test in utils.test.ts fails. Fix utils.ts and save the patch.

codex.reasoning: Run the test first to see the failure, then patch the regex to collapse runs and trim edge dashes, re-run, and save the diff.

steps.name: shell
steps.output:
bun test v1.4.2

utils.test.ts:
error: expect(received).toBe(expected)

Expected: "hello-world"
Received: "--hello---world--"

(fail) slugify collapses and trims dashes
 0 pass
 1 fail

steps.name: shell
apply_patch

arguments.input:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: utils.ts
@@
-  return input.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "-");
+  return input
+    .toLowerCase()
+    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
+    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
*** End Patch

steps.output:
Success. Updated the following files:
M utils.ts

steps.name: shell

command: bun test utils.test.ts | tee test-output.txt && git diff > fix.patch

steps.output:

utils.test.ts:
(pass) slugify collapses and trims dashes [0.21ms]

 1 pass
 0 fail
 1 expect() calls

codex.text: Fixed: slugify replaced every non-alphanumeric character with its own dash and never trimmed. It now collapses runs (`[^a-z0-9]+`) and trims leading/trailing dashes. The test passes; the diff is in fix.patch and the run log in test-output.txt.

claude-code.text:
The test expected `hello-world` but got `--hello---world--`: `slugify` turned each non-alphanumeric character into its own dash and never trimmed.

I changed the regex to collapse runs and trim the edges. The test now passes. **fix.patch** has the diff and **test-output.txt** the passing run.
